Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. As a Senior Commercial Counsel at Synthesia, you will work closely with our Sales, Marketing, Finance, Business Operations, and Go-To-Market organizations. Our team is a network of knowledgeable and supportive professionals who work as a unit, bringing bold ideas to the table and providing collaborative problem-solving. This role will report to the Director, Commercial Legal (NYC-based, overseeing commercial legal work for the Americas), and be responsible for various legal-related matters and projects involved with supporting the teams that sell and build our products. Responsibilities include: - Drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a variety of commercial agreements to support sales, partnerships, and our purchase of software and services from vendors. Your primary focus will be on our service agreements, software licenses, data processing agreements, and NDAs for our prospective customers. We’ll ask you to draw from the experience you’ve gained from supporting hundreds or thousands of commercial transactions to help define business terms and structure deals in an optimal way; - Advising on a variety of areas ranging from intellectual property, data privacy, data security, software licensing agreements, and go-to-market strategy; - Providing input on processes, policies, and playbooks to help scale the organization and make our team more effective and efficient; - Providing effective advice by staying up-to-date on relevant industry, commercial, open source, IP, privacy, employment, AI, and other laws, regulations, and developments; - Developing the company’s knowledge in areas of special interest, including intellectual property, data protection, financial services, healthcare, AI governance, and other regulatory matters; - Operating independently and providing practical, decisive guidance to our business teams that balances business objectives with legal risk, taking into account our company policies, practices and negotiation positions. You’re a great fit for the role if have the following characteristics: - Completion of a law degree from an accredited U.S. institution, and qualified to practice law as an in-house U.S. attorney; - 6+ years of post-qualification experience working on different kinds of commercial transactions (e.g., SaaS, IP licensing, software licensing, product resale, and distribution, working with contractors, outsourcing, facilities, etc.), including with large enterprise companies, companies in regulated industries (e.g., financial services, healthcare, etc.), government, and edu companies; - Experience working in an in-house legal department in the tech sector; bonus points for an AI company. - Comfortable negotiating data processing agreements, including a working knowledge of GDPR and CCPA as they relate to commercial contracts; - Clean and concise drafting of documents, policies, Slack messages, emails, and other communications in a manner that is digestible for non-lawyers; - Experience negotiating with enterprise customers, including on the customer’s form; - Understanding of cloud services, technology, and professional services contracts; - Knowledge of non-legal business processes gained in-house relating to sales operations and revenue recognition (i.e. experience with Order Forms and Statements of Work); - Experience managing workload on tight timelines with multiple competing demands; and - Exposure and experience negotiating artificial intelligence terms, including an understanding of AI models, IP ownership of inputs to and output from the models, and the use of training data for building such models. Perform data audits and reconciliations to identify and resolve data quality issues. Support HRIS data imports and other routine data maintenance activities. Assist with system testing for updates, enhancements, and fixes, including documenting test results and identifying issues. Create and maintain HRIS process documentation, knowledge articles, and user guides to support employees and HR partners. Identify recurring ticket trends and recommend opportunities to improve processes, documentation, and the employee experience. Partner with HR, Payroll, and other internal teams to ensure HRIS questions and issues are addressed accurately and in a timely manner. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with the ability to research issues and determine when escalation is needed. Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate and confidential employee data. Proficiency in Excel and comfort working with reports and employee data. Ability to manage multiple tickets and requests while prioritizing work based on urgency and business impact. Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-service mindset. Ability to work collaboratively with HR, Payroll, and cross-functional partners in a fast-paced environment. items.title: Engineering Manager, Credit Cards & Banking
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role The Credit Cards & Banking team is part of Robinhood’s Money Engineering organization. This team builds the products and systems behind some of Robinhood’s most ambitious consumer experiences, including Robinhood Gold Credit Card, Banking, and the next generation of card and banking products. This is a high-impact engineering leadership role at the intersection of product innovation, scale, and reliability. Our team owns the full customer experience end to end—from mobile and frontend surfaces to backend systems and the infrastructure that powers them. We work on products used by millions, in a space where execution quality, technical rigor, and customer trust matter deeply. As an Engineering Manager, you’ll lead a team of engineers building category-defining credit card and banking experiences. You’ll partner closely with product, design, data, compliance, operations, and peer engineering teams to define the roadmap, make sound technical decisions, and deliver exceptional products at scale. You’ll also play a central role in hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing team. We’re looking for bold thinkers, sharp problem-solvers, and leaders who want to help build the future of money. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY office(s), with in-person attendance expected 5 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Lead, grow, and support a team of software engineers working on Robinhood’s Credit Cards & Banking product area Set clear direction for the team across execution, technical design, and people development Partner with product managers, designers, and cross-functional stakeholders to define roadmaps and deliver high-impact customer experiences Drive the architecture, execution, and operational excellence needed to build reliable, scalable card and banking systems Guide engineering decisions across product surfaces, backend services, and platform dependencies Improve team health and effectiveness through strong planning, prioritization, feedback, and career development Hire exceptional engineers and raise the bar on talent, performance, and engineering craftsmanship Help the team move quickly while maintaining high standards for quality, reliability, and customer trust What you bring 8+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2+ years of experience managing engineering teams Experience leading teams that build and ship customer-facing products at scale Strong technical judgment and the ability to partner closely on architecture, tradeoffs, and execution Experience working on complex distributed systems, backend services, or full-stack consumer products A track record of driving cross-functional initiatives from concept through launch Experience coaching and developing engineers through regular feedback, performance management, and career growth Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical partner A high bar for execution, product quality, and building strong teams Leadership expectations Our ambitious roadmap requires strong leaders who can build both exceptional products and exceptional teams. We’re looking for someone who can: Drive high performance through clear goals, strong accountability, and fast learning Hire and retain top talent by setting a high bar and investing deeply in team development Create clarity in ambiguous, fast-moving environments Build trust across functions and keep teams aligned around customer and business impact Raise the quality of both technical execution and people leadership Bonus points Experience in fintech, banking, credit cards, payments, lending, or other highly regulated domains Experience leading teams through periods of rapid growth, product expansion, or platform scaling Experience building mobile-first or consumer app experiences Familiarity with modern backend and data systems in high-availability environments What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer - Moonpay Enterprise
items.description: MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove. This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend. MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes. AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters. You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together. The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running. The role We’re hiring backend engineers across several openings within MoonPay Enterprise. All roles share the same foundation of designing and operating reliable, secure, high-throughput backend services, but each opening has a distinct focus. When you apply, tell us which track (or tracks) excites you most. Track 1: KYB / KYC & Compliance Platform Build the systems that let enterprises onboard safely and stay compliant across dozens of jurisdictions. You’ll own services powering business (KYB) and individual (KYC) verification flows, risk scoring, sanctions and AML screening, case management, and integrations with identity and compliance vendors. The challenge is making rigorous compliance feel invisible: fast, automated, and globally scalable, without ever compromising on regulatory obligations. Track 2: New Product Lines, starting with Custody Join us at the ground floor of new enterprise products, beginning with Custody. You’ll design the backend for secure digital asset storage and management for institutional clients: key management workflows, policy engines, transaction authorization, ledger integrity, and audit trails. This track suits engineers who love ambiguity, greenfield architecture, and building products from zero to one with enterprise-grade security requirements. Track 3: Blockchain, Stablecoin Issuance & On-Chain Infrastructure Work directly with blockchain protocols to power our stablecoin issuance business and on-chain products. You’ll build and operate services for minting, burning, and managing fully reserved stablecoins across chains, develop smart contract integrations on EVM chains and Solana, and design the indexing, monitoring, and reconciliation systems that keep on-chain and off-chain state in sync. Prior Solana (Rust) or Solidity development experience is a strong plus here. Across all tracks, experience with fiat rails, banking integrations, or payments systems is very welcome. Much of our hardest work happens where traditional finance and crypto overlap. What you’ll do Design, build, and operate backend services written in Rust that process high volumes of financial transactions with strong guarantees around correctness, idempotency, and auditability Own features end to end, from shaping the product spec through technical design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring. You won’t just receive work from product: as a domain expert, you’ll help define what we build and propose the work you consider most useful Integrate with external partners such as banks, payment processors, blockchains, and identity and compliance vendors, and build the abstractions that make those integrations reliable Improve engineering quality across observability, incident response, security practices, and API design Collaborate closely with product, compliance, and other engineering teams across MoonPay’s global network (Staff level) Set technical direction for your area, mentor other engineers, and drive architectural decisions that span multiple teams About you 5+ years of backend engineering experience (8+ for Staff), with a track record of shipping and operating production systems at scale Strong backend experience with a statically compiled language (e.g. Rust, Go, C#, C++) is a must. Deep fundamentals matter more to us than your specific language history Prior professional Rust experience is not required, but interest in Rust and motivation to become an expert in it are very welcome, since our services are written in Rust Solid fundamentals in distributed systems, API design, data modeling, and asynchronous processing Comfort working in domains where precision matters, such as financial systems, double-entry ledgers, reconciliation, or similarly correctness-critical software A pragmatic, autonomous, ownership-driven mindset. You care about outcomes, communicate clearly, and thrive on high throughput: on this team, features ship in hours to days and products in days to weeks Strong critical thinking, including in how you use AI tools. You know how to drive AI-assisted development productively while staying firmly in control of correctness, security, and design quality Interest in crypto, stablecoins, and the future of payments. Prior crypto experience is a plus rather than a requirement, except for Track 3, where hands-on blockchain development experience is expected Bonus points Professional or hobby experience writing Rust (open-source contributions count!) Experience in fiat payments, banking integrations, card networks, or PSPs Familiarity with KYC/KYB, AML, sanctions screening, or regulated financial products (Track 1) Background in custody, key management (MPC/HSM), or institutional-grade security (Track 2) Smart contract development in Solidity (EVM) or Rust (Solana), and experience with on-chain indexing or node infrastructure (Track 3) Experience working in regulated, multi-jurisdiction environments How we work MoonPay Enterprise operates like a startup inside a scale-up: small, senior, high-throughput teams with real ownership, direct access to customers and decision-makers, and the backing of MoonPay’s global licenses, banking relationships, and distribution network. We move fast and expect engineers to act as product owners for their domain, not just implementers. This role is open as a hybrid position from our Berlin, London and New York offices. This is a high-ownership role with minimal bureaucracy and a strong bias toward execution. items.title: Marketing General Application
items.location_text: London, New York City, Austin, Munich, Berlin, Paris
items.description: Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US. As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations. Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow. WHY THIS JOB POSTING We are always on the lookout for exceptional talent. The best hires rarely arrive the moment a perfectly matching job posting happens to be live. So we're not waiting. You might not fit one of our current open roles, and that's fine. If you're genuinely great at what you do, we want you, and we'll find work for you! Tell us what you're brilliant at and where you'd have the most impact, and we'll figure out the right seat together. WHAT IT'S LIKE TO WORK HERE A few things that are true about working here: We move fast. Really fast. Hours and days, not weeks or months. We keep it light. Few meetings, little bureaucracy, less talking and more doing. And we default to doing it ourselves before adding dependencies, because pulling other people in slows everything down for everyone. We hold a high bar. Average loses. Even good often does. We're here to do the best work of our careers, and we back each other to get there, low ego, high trust. It's not an easy game. We're in AI, the most competitive space in the world, and nobody is going to give us this market. We have to take it. But the impact is real. You'll see your work land. If you want to build things you're proud of, this is the place. WHERE YOU MIGHT FIT We hire top talent across the whole function. A few of the areas where you might fit: - Performance. Own paid end to end and turn spend into pipeline and revenue. - Growth. Own the experiments and loops that compound over time. - Field. Own the events and 1:1 and 1:few plays that accelerate deals by region. - SEO. Win traditional and AI search. Ship the best content and world-class landing pages. - Brand and Creative. Make Synthesia impossible to ignore. - Copywriting. Write copy that lands. Make every word earn its place. - Organic Social. Build organic presence across platforms. Go viral with content people love. - Product and Customer Marketing. Position it. Launch it. Tell the story. - Lifecycle. Turn new signups into engaged customers who stick and grow. - Analytics and Measurement. Turn data into the team's sharpest decisions. Not seeing your exact discipline? Apply anyway and tell us where you'd have the most impact. ABOUT YOU - You get results. Pipeline, adoption, revenue. You can point to the numbers. - You live in the data. You reach for the numbers and tell signal from noise. - You can write. Sharp positioning and copy, with a point of view you'll defend. - You own it. Blank slate, your call. You move and adjust based on what works. - You run solo. You get things done without pulling in a crowd. - You adapt fast. Priorities shift, channels change, AI rewrites the playbook. You keep up. - You love AI. You want to build a category-defining product at one of the fastest-growing AI companies in the world. APPLY Apply here. In a line or two, tell us where you fit and what you'd want to own. We review on a rolling basis, and when there's a match with a current or upcoming role, we'll reach out. What you share stays with us for future openings too. Want to skip the queue? Message Borys Khodan, VP of Marketing, on LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/borkho/ and make your case: - Where you'd have the most impact. A few sharp bullet points. - What you're proudest of. Real wins, with the numbers behind them. Show us the work. That's what gets our attention. items.title: Staff Backend Engineer - Sports
items.description: ABOUT THE ROLE LeoVegas Group is building a world-class Sportsbook platform. Within the Sports domain, we work in a high-volume, real-time environment where speed, correctness, scalability and reliability are critical, building the services that transform incoming sports, trading and pricing data into experiences used by millions of customers. We are looking for a highly experienced Staff Backend Engineer to help lead the design, development and evolution of these distributed systems. You will provide technical leadership across architecture, engineering practices and platform evolution while remaining hands-on, helping teams make better technical decisions, raise engineering standards, simplify complex systems and balance business needs with long-term platform health. This role suits someone who enjoys understanding the technical and business context behind problems rather than implementing solutions mechanically. We value engineers who are curious and proactive, comfortable with ambiguity, and who lead through collaboration and ownership rather than authority. WHAT YOU'LL DO • Lead architecture and design discussions for scalable, resilient and maintainable distributed systems, evaluating options through spikes, experiments and proofs of concept. • Drive simplification of complex systems while holding a high bar for performance, reliability and code quality. • Identify scalability, resiliency and operational risks before they reach production, and lead root cause analysis when incidents occur. • Improve observability, monitoring and operational readiness, and drive down technical debt across the platform. • Promote best practices around event-driven and reactive architectures, performance optimisation, testing, automation and CI/CD. • Mentor engineers through design reviews, code reviews, pair programming and technical guidance. • Partner with Product, Engineering Managers and Architects to translate business problems into practical solutions, and help shape and break down technical initiatives. • Contribute to a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and engineering excellence. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR ESSENTIAL SKILLS • Proven experience designing, building and operating distributed systems at scale, owning complex backend systems end-to-end in production. • Strong backend expertise in Java (preferably 21+), with a solid understanding of JVM internals, concurrency and multithreading. • Hands-on experience with Reactive Programming and non-blocking systems using Spring Boot and/or Vert.x. • Hands-on experience with Apache Kafka and event-driven architectures; familiarity with streaming and messaging technologies such as Redis or NATS. • Experience with Redis for caching and low-latency data access, and with SQL and NoSQL databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, MariaDB, MongoDB). • Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Grafana or Kibana, and with debugging complex production incidents. • Strong system design and architectural decision-making, balancing latency, throughput, consistency, operational complexity and maintainability. • Ability to influence technical decisions and communicate effectively with engineers, architects, product managers and other stakeholders. NICE TO HAVE • Experience with Kubernetes, AWS and/or GCP, and cloud-native architecture patterns. • Experience with OpenSearch and/or Elasticsearch for search, analytics and operational troubleshooting. • Experience building internal platforms, shared frameworks or developer productivity tooling, with a strong SRE mindset. • Experience within sports betting, gaming or other real-time, data-intensive domains. WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE • Teams rely on you for technical direction and practical problem-solving, and move faster thanks to the foundations, tooling, standards and guidance you help establish. • The platform becomes more reliable, scalable and easier to operate over time, with fewer production incidents. • Technical decisions are made with greater clarity, consistency and long-term sustainability. • Cross-team dependencies are better coordinated, reducing friction and improving delivery. • Engineers grow technically through your mentorship, feedback and leadership. WHO WE ARE At the core of LeoVegas Group is Team Leo. Our culture is our foundation and is what enables us to innovate, build and lead as we trailblaze our way through the igaming industry. We're a team of over 2000 innovators, initiators and groundbreakers working in a fast-paced and agile environment across 21 offices worldwide. WHAT WE OFFER • Competitive salary aligned with your experience, expertise and impact. • A collaborative, inclusive and fast-paced engineering environment where ideas are welcomed, ownership is encouraged and continuous learning is valued. • Hybrid work policy and 4 weeks of Workation (T&Cs apply). • Benefits package - 800 PLN net (B2B)/gross (UOP) monthly with access to the cafeteria platform (private medical care, insurances, sports card). • Training budget and the ICAS assistance programme for support during challenging moments. • Complimentary snacks and drinks in the office, with complimentary breakfast on Mondays. • Team and office social events throughout the year. • Free parking for bicycles and motorcycles, and a free gym in the building. • Equipment: MacBook Pro and smartphone (iPhone 16/17 or Samsung Galaxy S25). JOIN US! In our pride, we empower our teammates to find their roar and run with their wildest ideas. We don't wait for things to happen; we pounce and make it happen! Would you be a good fit for the Leo Pride - give us a roar! As our company working language is English, we'd like to see your CV in English, please.
